definitions.explanation: Strong anger or displeasure aroused by something perceived as unjust, unfair, or wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{憤慨|ふんがい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{憤慨|ふんがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I felt indignant at his attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{憤慨|ふんがい}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Citizens are outraged by the government's response.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {憤|ふん} (indignation, resent) + {慨|がい} (lament, deplore). Both characters carry meanings of strong displeasure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{憤慨|ふんがい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be indignant, to be outraged)
・{憤慨|ふんがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to feel indignation)
・{憤慨|ふんがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{余|あま}り→余り：17255_amari⟧ (out of sheer indignation)
・～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{憤慨|ふんがい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be indignant at ~)

USAGE NOTE: {憤慨|ふんがい} describes righteous anger against perceived injustice or wrongdoing, rather than personal annoyance. It often implies moral outrage.

REGISTER: Formal/literary. Common in news articles and formal written language.

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧ (anger - more general)
・⟦{激怒|げきど}→激怒：08681_gekido⟧ (fury, rage - more intense)
・⟦{立腹|りっぷく}→立腹：20187_rippuku⟧ (anger, offense - formal)
・⟦{義憤|ぎふん}→義憤：14015_gifun⟧ (righteous indignation)
・⟦{慨嘆|がいたん}→慨嘆：noentry⟧ (lamentation, deploring)

CONTRAST:
・{憤慨|ふんがい}: moral outrage at injustice
・⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧/⟦{怒|いか}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧: general anger
・⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to get angry (casual)
